title: Edge traversal on Tailscale-Process was turned off -> blocked (silent NAT-traversal loss)
titleZh: Tailscale-Process 的边缘遍历被关掉 -> blocked(NAT 穿透静默失效)
why: Failures F24 in the failure library: the rule that must be inspected is the PROCESS rule Tailscale-Process; Tailscale-In is expected to be Edge=No, so reading the wrong rule concludes 'no drift'. This case pins both halves: the drift is caught from the stored registry value, and the Tailscale-In judgement stays pass so the two are not confused.
inject: the stored Tailscale-Process rule carries Edge=FALSE while Tailscale-In is untouched
expectSummary: TAILSCALE_PROCESS_EDGE_DB blocked/edge_false while TAILSCALE_IN_RULES stays pass, exit 2
